verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU,Mukama wange,
Laba nze ndi muddu wo;
Saasira-obuto bwange
Njagala-okujja gy'oli.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Mwana gw'endiga,Yesu,
Naawe wafuuka-omwana,
Bwe ndowooza-ekisa kyo,
Njagala-okukulaba.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ontegeeze bulijjo
Ebinsaanidde byonna,
Nnyiikirenga okukula-
Nga nkufaanana Yesu.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Era n'obuwombeefu,
Bonna ka mbaweereze;
Era okwagalana-ennyo
Ka ndagenga bulijjo.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ekyo ndikiyinza ntya?
Nga nkusaba bulijjo
Ggwe-ateesanyusa mu nsi
Ggwe nnannyini bulungi.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Bwe ntyo bwe naayinzanga
-Okukuweereza Yesu;
Bonna-abantunuulira
Bandabe nga-omuddu wo.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Bwe ntyo bwe naasanyusa
Katonda ow'okwagala
Nga mugulumiriza
Mu mirimu gye nkola.
